messages:
linda_support: Customer Acme (acct: acme-inc) reports intermittent 502s hitting POST /v1/generate. Seen across a few requests since 2026-03-12T10:23Z. Two example trace ids: gZ3-9b12, gZ3-9b15. They say the requests include long metadata headers (x-acme-tags, x-billing-context). Can we triage?

jonathan_oncall: Thanks, tagging eng-sre + runtime. Any curl we can use to repro?

linda_support: Sample repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \n  -H "x-acme-tags: tag1,tag2,tag3,...,tagN (very long)" \n  -H "x-billing-context: {long json}" \n  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```

maria_sre: I pulled the router logs for those trace ids. Envoy/router shows upstream reset and 502 returned. Example line:
```
[2026-03-12T10:23:44Z] router error: upstream reset: connection termination while processing request, route=/v1/generate, response_code=502, bytes_sent=0, trace_id=gZ3-9b12
```
Looks like frontdoor (envoy) isn't handing off to upstream. Could be header parsing or connection reset.

kevin_runtime: My first suspicion is header size / parsing. Envoy (and some LB configs) can behave poorly when header blocks exceed configured limits and that sometimes surfaces as 502 instead of 431 depending on where it fails. Can you capture the total header size from a repro?

linda_support: I ran the repro and measured header block ~92KB for that request. Also saw same behavior in eu-central when customer duplicated request.

maria_sre: 92KB would be above some defaults. Envoy has `max_headers_kb` (per route/listener) and some proxies in path might be stricter. When header parsing fails in certain stages we see upstream resets because the connection is closed mid-parse.

kevin_runtime: Proposed plan:
- Short-term mitigation: strip non-essential long headers at edge (x-acme-tags) with a header-rewrite rule so request size is below threshold.
- Short + medium: increase `max_headers_kb` on edge envoy listener to 128KB and deploy as a canary (10% traffic) in us-west first.
- Long-term: ask customer to paginate/condense tags and add a validation warning in API SDKs.

linda_support: Action items:
- @kevin_runtime -> prepare envoy config change and canary (10% us-west).
- @maria_sre -> add a temporary edge header strip rule for acme-inc (tenant id) via rate-limited route rewrite.
- @jonathan_oncall -> monitor error rate and rollback criteria (502 > baseline x5 for 5m).

deploy-bot: Rollout started: `edge/edge-envoy-config#increase-max-headers` -> canary=10% (us-west). CI: passed.

jonathan_oncall: Monitoring dashboards: started watching 502 rate for acme-inc and global. I'll post metrics in 5m. Also created ticket RGW-1524 to track.

alex_acme: We can trim the tag payload but our tag generator emits 100+ tags per request for some flows. Trimming will be a breaking change for our data pipeline. Would prefer platform fix.

kevin_runtime: Understood. That's why we'll do canary first. If canary looks good we can widen. Also adding a header-length metric to edge logs to capture future cases.

maria_sre: Captured a pcap of the failing session and full envoy debug logs saved to s3://redwood-debug/pcap/3923456789.pcap. If we need to replay we have it.

linda_support: Customer updated: ok with temporary workaround if we avoid breaking their SDKs. They want ETA. Can we get canary->50% within 2 hours if green?

jonathan_oncall: Yes, if canary shows no spike in 502 or CPU/memory anomalies we'll promote to 50% then global. Rollback keyword: `rollback/edge-max-headers`.

kevin_runtime: I'll post the envoy snippet I'm applying to the canary (config excerpt):
```yaml
listener_filters:
  - name: envoy.router
route_config:
  virtual_hosts:
    - name: api-vhost
      domains: ["api.redwood.com"]
      request_headers_to_add: # will still strip via header rewrite for tenant rule
      ...
http_protocol_options:
  max_headers_kb: 128
```

linda_support: Thanks team. I'll keep ACME notified and update this thread. :thumbsup:

maria_sre: Post-canary note: if we still see any 502 about parsing, check upstream LB parsing between edge and internal proxies; we might need a matching config there.

jonathan_oncall: 5m check: 502 rate for acme-inc dropped to 0.8x baseline after canary (previously ~3x). Continuing monitor.

linda_support: Customer replied: "Thanks, we see immediate improvement — we'll schedule tagging changes on our side but appreciate the fix." Closing loop once global rollout completes. :tada:
